what: Experimental synthesis after the Forge TME VHIKK X: nine algorithms for drones, basses and textures through a FIELD filter into a metallic DUNGEON or a diffuse REFLEKTA delay with a frequency shifter in its feedback. WARP, SPAN, MORPH, FUSE, SEED, SCAN, TIME, MIX, FEED, FORM, CELL as on the module, plus HOLD, DICE and FREEZE.
author: swtdr34mz
